PLAN "12-Week Fat Loss & Glycaemic Control (Diabetic-Friendly)"

/* TYPE and VISIBILITY */
TYPE workout
VISIBILITY public

GOALS
  GOAL primary strength:
    name "Fat loss with improved glycaemic control; HbA1c management; strength maintenance"

PHASES
  PHASE "Phase 1" (4 weeks):
    WEEK 1:
      DAY Monday training 50m "Full-Body Foundations A":
        warmup:
          cardio 5 minutes
          dynamic_mlex 5 minutes
        main straight_sets:
          Leg_press 3x10 rpe 7 rest 90 seconds
          Dumbbell_Squat 3x8..12 rpe 7 rest 90 seconds
          Lat_Pulldown 3x10 rpe 7 rest 90 seconds
          Dumbbell_Bench_Press 3x8..12 rpe 7 rest 90 seconds
          Seated_Row 3x10 rpe 7 rest 90 seconds
          Hip_Extension (RDL) 3x8..12 rpe 7 rest 90 seconds
          Plank 3x30s rpe 5 rest 60 seconds
        cooldown:
          treadmill_walk 5 minutes
          mobility_4_points 5 minutes
      DAY Wednesday training 50m "Full-Body Foundations B":
        warmup:
          bike 5 minutes
          dynamic_mobility 5 minutes
        main straight_sets:
          Leg_Curl 3x10 rpe 7 rest 90 seconds
          Bulgarian_Split_Squat 3x8..12 rpe 7 rest 90 seconds
          Seated_Row 3x10 rpe 7 rest 90 seconds
          Push_ups 3x8..12 rpe 7 rest 90 seconds
          Dumbbell_Lateral_Raise 3x12 rpe 7 rest 60 seconds
          Cable_Race_Porce 3x10 rpe 7 rest 90 seconds
          Farmer_Carries 3x30s rpe 6 rest 60 seconds
        cooldown:
          foam_roll 5 minutes
          mobility_5 minutes
      DAY Friday training 50m "Conditioning & Core":
        warmup:
          brisk_walk 5 minutes
          mobility_5 minutes
        main straight_sets:
          Treadmill_intervals 6x60s fast/90s easy rpe 8 rest 60 seconds
          Kettlebell_Swings 3x15 rpe 7 rest 60 seconds
          Bicycle_Crunch 3x20r rpe 5 rest 30 seconds
          Pallof_Pi llow_anti_rot 3x12 each side rpe 6 rest 60 seconds
        cooldown:
          walk 5 minutes
          mobility_5 minutes
    WEEK 2:
      DAY Monday training 50m "Full-Body Foundations A + RPE progression":
        warmup:
          cardio 5 minutes
          dynamic_mobility 5 minutes
        main:
          Leg_Press 3x10 rpe 7.5 rest 90 seconds
          Dumbbell_Squat 3x10 rpe 7.5 rest 90 seconds
          Lat_Pulldown 3x10 rpe 7.5 rest 90 seconds
          Dumbbell_Bench_Press 3x10 rpe 7.5 rest 90 seconds
          Seated_Row 3x10 rpe 7.5 rest 90 seconds
          Hip_Extension 3x10 rpe 7.5 rest 90 seconds
          Plank 3x40s rpe 5 rest 60 seconds
        cooldown:
          walk 5 minutes
      DAY Wednesday training 50m "Full-Body Foundations B + tempo tweaks":
        warmup:
          bike 5 minutes
          dynamic_mobility 5 minutes
        main:
          Leg_Curl 3x10 rpe 7.5 rest 90 seconds
          Bulgarian_Split_Squat 3x9..12 rpe 7.5 rest 90 seconds
          Seated_Row 3x10 rpe 7.5 rest 90 seconds
          Push_ups 3x9..12 rpe 7.5 rest 90 seconds
          Dumbbell_Lateral_Raise 3x12 rpe 7.5 rest 60 seconds
          Cable_Rotation 3x12 each side rpe 6.5 rest 60 seconds
          Farmer_Carries 3x40s rpe 6 rest 60 seconds
        cooldown:
          foam_roll 5 minutes
      DAY Friday training 50m "Conditioning & Core + Diabetes-Friendly Intervals":
        warmup:
          brisk_walk 5 minutes
          mobility_5 minutes
        main:
          Treadmill_intervals 8x45s fast/75s easy rpe 8 rest 60 seconds
          Kettlebell_Swings 3x15 rpe 7 rest 60 seconds
          Side_Plank 3x30s each side rpe 5 rest 30 seconds
          Bird_Dog 3x12 each side rpe 5 rest 30 seconds
        cooldown:
          walk 5 minutes
  PHASE "Phase 2" (4 weeks):
    WEEK 1:
      DAY Monday training 55m "Push-Pull Strength + Conditioning":
        warmup:
          bike 5 minutes
          dynamic_mobility 5 minutes
        main:
          Barbell_Back_Squat 4x6 rpe 7.5 rest 120 seconds
          Barbell_Overhead_Press 3x8 rpe 7 rest 120 seconds
          Barbell_Bench_Press 4x6 rpe 7.5 rest 120 seconds
          Inverted_Row 3x10 rpe 7 rest 90 seconds
          Dumbbell_Cetal_Calf 3x12 rest 60 seconds
          Dumbbell_ Romanian_Deadlift 3x10 rpe 7 rest 90 seconds
        cooldown:
          mobility_5 minutes
      DAY Wednesday training 55m "Lower Body Hypertrophy + Core":
        warmup:
          treadmill 5 minutes
          dynamic_mobility 5 minutes
        main:
          Leg_ Press 4x10 rpe 7 rest 90 seconds
          Romanian_Deadlift 3x8..12 rpe 7 rest 90 seconds
          Leg_Curl 3x10 rpe 7 rest 90 seconds
          Walking_Lunge 3x12 each leg rpe 7 rest 90 seconds
          Cable_Ab_Rollout 3x12 rpe 5 rest 60 seconds
        cooldown:
          foam_roll 5 minutes
      DAY Friday training 55m "Metabolic Finisher & Core":
        warmup:
          rower 5 minutes
          mobility 5 minutes
        main:
          Circuit 4 rounds:
            Jump_Squat 12 reps
            Push_ups 12 reps
            Kettlebell_Swings 15 reps
            Mountain_Digits 30s
            Plank_To_Pushup 8 reps
          rest 90 seconds between rounds
        cooldown:
          walk 5 minutes
    WEEK 2:
      [Repeat with progressive overload targets; maintain RPE 7–7.5, adjust load up slightly]

NUTRITION PLAN
  OVERVIEW
    - Calorie target: modest deficit tuned to 20–25% below maintenance; adjust weekly based on weight, energy, and glycaemic response.
    - Macros: Protein 1.6–2.0 g/kg bodyweight/day; fat 25–35% of total calories; remaining calories from complex carbohydrates.
    - Fiber: 25–38 g/day. Hydration: 2.5–3.5 L/day depending on activity and environment.
    - Glycaemic targets: HbA1c 7.0–7.2 baseline; aim fasting glucose 90–130 mg/dL; postprandial <180 mg/dL.
  - Meal timing
    - Eat every 3–4 hours to stabilize glucose.
    - Include protein with every meal (25–40 g) and a source of fiber.
    - Pre/post-workout nutrition: 20–40 g high-glycemic or moderate-giber to support training if energy is low; otherwise choose balanced carbs.
  - Carbohydrate choices
    - Focus on low glycemic index foods: whole grains (oats, quinoa), legumes, vegetables, fruits (berries, citrus), and dairy.
    - Spread carbohydrate intake around workouts to improve glycemic control.
  - Protein sources
    - Lean meats, fish, eggs, dairy, legumes, tofu, tempeh; consider 30–40 g per meal for satiety and muscle maintenance.
  - Fats
    - Emphasize unsaturated fats: olive oil, avocados, nuts, seeds; avoid excessive saturated fats.
  - Fiber and micronutrients
    - Emphasize non-starchy vegetables; consider magnesium, chromium, and vitamin D status; discuss with clinician if considering supplementation.
  - Metformin considerations
    - Maintain hydration, avoid very low carb days abruptly; monitor for GI side effects and blood sugar changes.
    - Monitor fasting glucose levels; adjust carbohydrate timing if hypo/hyperglycemia observed.
  - Diabetic-specific guidelines
    - Use diabetes-appropriate snacks if training around meals (e.g., 15–20 g fast-acting carbs if glucose < 90 mg/dL).
    - Post-exercise glucose often improves; monitor 1–2 hours post-exercise for glycemic response.
  - Sample day plan (target 1800–2100 kcal, adjust to client metrics)
    - Breakfast: 2 eggs + 2 egg whites omelet with spinach, tomatoes; 1 slice whole-grain toast; 1 small apple.
    - Snack: Greek yogurt (150 g) with 1 tbsp chia seeds; berries.
    - Lunch: Grilled chicken (150 g) with quinoa (1 cup cooked) and mixed vegetables; olive oil 1 tbsp.
    - Snack: Apple with 20 g almonds.
    - Dinner: Salmon (150 g) with roasted vegetables and a small baked potato; leafy greens salad with vinaigrette.
    - Optional: protein shake post-workout if intake goals unmet.
  - Diabetic safety notes
    - Check with clinician before starting any supplementation; avoid high-sugar pre-packaged meals.
    - Monitor symptoms of hypo/hyperglycemia; carry fast-acting carbohydrates.
  - Progress monitoring
    - Weekly weigh-ins, body measurements every 2 weeks, HbA1c every 8–12 weeks via clinician; adjust nutrition plan accordingly.
  - Education and adherence
    - Teach portion control; provide simple plate method guidelines: half plate non-starchy vegetables, quarter protein, quarter carbs.
    - Encourage sleep 7–9 hours and stress management; both affect glycemic control.

Notes
- This is a 12-week plan with progressive resistance training focused on full-body strength maintenance and fat loss, complemented by conditioning workouts to improve insulin sensitivity.
- Customization: adjust volume and intensity based on the client's progression, injuries, and energy levels. Regularly review glucose logs and symptoms with the client and their healthcare provider.
